line: Crowley's Princess of Wands: Hé final of the Name (pdf p140); the earthy part of Fire and one quadrant of the heavens about the North Pole (pdf p147).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princesses (pdf p140) and on the Princess of Wands (pdf p147).

quotes.quote: The Princesses represent the Hé final of the Name.
The Princess of Wands represents the earthy part of Fire; one might say, she is the fuel of Fire.

sections.title: Its place in the heavens
sections.line: Crowley on the Princesses and the Zodiac (pdf p140); on the Princess of Wands and the heavens (pdf p147).

quotes.quote: The Princesses have no Zodiacal attribution.
She rules the Heavens for one quadrant of the portion around the North Pole.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Princess of Wands (pdf p147).

quotes.quote: The character of the Princess is extremely individual.
